cipher.name: QWERTY monoalphabetic substitution cipher
cipher.idea: A fixed one-to-one substitution over the English alphabet. Each plaintext letter is replaced by exactly one ciphertext letter using a single bijection, and the mapping is the same for uppercase and lowercase letters. Non-letter characters are left unchanged.
cipher.encrypt_rules: Use the following bijection: plaintext alphabet abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz -> ciphertext alphabet qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm. Thus a->q, b->w, c->e, d->r, e->t, f->y, g->u, h->i, i->o, j->p, k->a, l->s, m->d, n->f, o->g, p->h, q->j, r->k, s->l, t->z, u->x, v->c, w->v, x->b, y->n, z->m. Uppercase letters use the same mapping, preserving case. All non-letter characters remain unchanged.
